address: 5 Clipstone Street, Fitzrovia, London, W1W 6BB, United Kingdom
bio: Sister to fellow neighbourhood spots Portland and 64 Goodge Street, this well-run restaurant provides a great all-round package. The young team are full of smiles, the wine list is cleverly conceived and there’s a pleasing buzz to the atmosphere. The cooking, for its part, showcases quality ingredients and an original touch in somewhat delicate dishes....
